name: SwiftTools Meta CSV Manager
author: swifttools

sections.description:
SwiftTools Meta CSV Manager allows you to easily update your page and post meta titles and descriptions in bulk by uploading a simple CSV file. Perfect for SEO professionals and site owners looking to save time on on-page optimization.

Features:
* Bulk upload meta titles and descriptions via CSV.
* Export existing pages to CSV for easy editing.
* Subscriptions and usage tracking for power users.
* Easy to use interface.

External services

This plugin connects to an API to process CSV files for bulk updating meta titles and descriptions.

It sends your uploaded CSV data (which includes URLs, meta titles, and descriptions), as well as your WordPress site URL and email address (for subscription tracking), to our external service when you upload a CSV or activate a subscription.

This service is provided by “SwiftTools” (hosted on Heroku: meta-field-uploader-37454fa656cd.herokuapp.com).
– Terms of use: https://meta-field-uploader-37454fa656cd.herokuapp.com/terms
– Privacy policy: https://meta-field-uploader-37454fa656cd.herokuapp.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/swifttools-meta-csv-manager directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the SwiftTools Meta CSV Manager menu in your WordPress admin dashboard to upload your CSV file or export your current pages.
sections.faq:
How do I format the CSV file?

The CSV file should have the appropriate columns for Post ID, Title, and Description. We recommend using the export functionality first to get a perfectly formatted template for your site.
